checks.name: Stop is set
checks.detail: No stop price in the plan. Without a stop the loss is uncapped: the whole position is at risk.

checks.name: Invalidation is written
checks.detail: No invalidation is written. A plan with no stated condition for being wrong cannot be exited on a rule.

checks.name: Risk is within the cap
checks.detail: Risk $100.00 (10.00% of the account) is above the allowed $10.00 (min of $10.00 and 1.0% of the account). Cut the position or move the stop closer.

checks.name: Risk/reward is at least the minimum
checks.detail: Risk/reward is 0.50, below the minimum 1.5. Reward $50.00 against risk $100.00. Move the target further or the stop closer.

checks.name: Position is within the size limit
checks.detail: Position $100.00 is 10.00% of the account, above the 8.0% limit. A single position this large concentrates the account.

checks.name: Thesis is written
checks.detail: Thesis is written: 'It will go up.'.

checks.name: Honeypot check passed
checks.detail: The honeypot check did not pass (value: 'not-checked'). Do not enter an on-chain trade that has not passed the honeypot gate.

checks.name: Analyst score passes the bar
checks.detail: No analyst score is given, so no score bar applies.

next_action: Do not enter. A hard fail means the plan has no usable stop, risks more than the cap, or states no invalidation. Rewrite the plan.
